Riley (Head of Private): FYI team — publishing a new policy and pilot: Customer-Controlled Patch Approval (CCPA) for Private/VPC customers. Purpose: let customers opt into a supervised flow where they approve signed fixes before application. Pilot is invite-only (10 accounts). Pilot docs + sign-up: https://intranet.redwood/ccpa-pilot :sparkles:
Tao (Infrastructure): Short tech summary: CCPA adds an approval webhook and an ephemeral staging window. Workflow:
1) Redwood uploads signed repair image to customer staging bucket
2) Customer triggers approval webhook OR auto-approve after X hours
3) Image is applied during agreed maintenance window
We recommend default auto-approve timeout = 48h.
June (Security): Telemetry & compliance: pilot telemetry limited to image hashes, approval timestamps, and outcome flags. No model or customer data is exfiltrated. All images signed via HSM = attestation plus SBOM provided. Compliance writeup: https://intranet.redwood/security/ccpa :lock:
Ben (Customer Success): I'll reach out to pilot candidates this afternoon. Need a one-page customer-facing flow diagram and a short consent addendum explaining opt-in vs. auto-approve behavior.
Riley (Head of Private): Policy highlight: when CCPA moves GA we'll require customers on our managed Private support tier to choose between: 1) automatic signed repair application (no extra consent) or 2) CCPA opt-in with explicit approval windows. We'll provide customers 60 days notice before making automatic application mandatory for proactive security fixes. :warning:
legal-bot: Reminder: any changes that affect customer obligations need Legal review. Please have consent language to Legal by Tuesday.
Tao (Infrastructure): Ops snippet (example webhook payload):
```
{
  "image_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "release_id": "ccpa-2026-03",
  "staging_bucket": "s3://cust-1234/staging",
  "expires_at": "2026-04-05T12:00:00Z"
}
```
Tao (Infrastructure): Rollout plan (high level): canary -> beta (25%) -> full pilot invites. Health checks after apply: 5m, 15m, 60m. Automatic rollback triggers if node error rate >6% within 15m.
June (Security): Action: we'll publish signed SBOMs and an attestation bundle per image; add CCPA pilot to SOC tracker. Customers that demand zero-telemetry must use the offline repair image workflow (longer SLA).
Ben (Customer Success): Customer blurb draft: "CCPA gives you full control over when signed fixes are applied. You can approve manually or set an auto-approve timeout. If you decline all remote repair workflows, recovery will be manual and may increase RTO. Contact your CSM to enroll or request an exemption." I'll tailor per account.
Riley (Head of Private): Pilot timeline: week 0 invite -> weeks 1-2 webhook & staging runs -> week 3 dry-run apply + rollback -> week 4 feedback + GA readiness.
deploy-bot: CCPA-preview v0.1 -> infra-staging at 2087654500
Tao (Infrastructure): Note: please validate customer staging bucket ACLs before invite. Misconfigured ACLs will block webhook deliveries.
legal-bot: Legal action: circulating consent addendum draft; please comment by EOD Wednesday.
Riley (Head of Private): If anyone objects to the 60-day notice or the 48h default auto-approve timeout, reply here before EOD Friday. Otherwise we'll lock the pilot invites tomorrow and start outreach. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
